about.title: Who I am
about.description: I am a Data Scientist with a background in Mechanical Engineering and a trajectory shaped by technically demanding problems. My work combines applied research, engineering, and software development across stages such as data structuring, modeling, experimentation, and implementation. I am especially interested in Oil & Gas, Energy, optimization, Machine Learning systems, and recent applications of generative AI.
